body.title: Export the store's keys and checks, and correct its comments
body.summary: In session-store.ts export INDEX_KEY, SESSION_PREFIX, isSession and updatedAtOf so the file store and the migration use the same keys and checks (review finding accepted by override). Correct the file header ('no local-JSON file') and the ChatSession.liveTurn comment ('Sessions live in globalState') to say sessions are kept in files under ~/.insrc/chat-sessions. No behaviour changes.
acceptanceChecks: INDEX_KEY, SESSION_PREFIX, isSession and updatedAtOf are exported from session-store.ts with their values and behaviour unchanged
The header and the liveTurn comment name the files, not globalState
Every existing session-store test still passes unchanged

tests.name: INDEX_KEY, SESSION_PREFIX, isSession and updatedAtOf are exported from session-store.ts and are the keys and checks the memento store itself uses
